citation: Reynolds AC, et al. 2012. Impact of Five Nights of Sleep Restriction on Glucose Metabolism, Leptin and Testosterone in Young Adult Men. PLoS ONE 7:e41218.
protocol: 2 baseline nights 10 h in bed (22:00-08:00), then 5 nights 4 h in bed (04:00-08:00), recovery night 10 h; blood at 09:00 (fasting) then every 2 h 10:00-20:00 on B1 and SR5
population: n=14 healthy men, age 27.4 +/- 3.8 y, BMI 23.5 +/- 2.9 kg/m2
